 Job Description: 
 The Opportunity

 As a Project Engineer, you will manage engineering orders for high-voltage service products from initial requirements through production release. You will prepare designs, specifications, schedules, cost estimates, drawings, bills of materials, and production instructions while ensuring parts lists are complete and accurate. Working closely with Production, Sales, and other engineering team members, you will communicate order updates, address technical inquiries, and support the timely execution of standard and emergency orders. You will also develop knowledge across the service portfolio, prepare technical instructions, support SAP part number and bill-of-material activities, and identify opportunities to improve engineering processes. This is an office-based position in Mount Pleasant, Pennsylvania. Relocation assistance may be available for the selected candidate.

 This is an office-based position in Mount Pleasant, PA 
 
How You’ll Make an Impact

 Create engineering orders and ensure generated parts lists are complete and accurate.
 Prepare designs, specifications, schedules, cost estimates, production-order bills of materials, and production instructions.
 Create and modify electrical and mechanical drawings and engraving templates based on made-to-order and engineering-order requirements.
 Develop cost-effective engineered products that meet sales-order requirements while eliminating non-value-added costs from parts lists.
 Take ownership of assigned engineering orders, provide weekly status updates, and support the rapid execution of emergency orders.
 Collaborate with Production and Sales to prepare engineering orders and create new customer offerings.
 Support SAP part number loading and bill-of-material creation, respond to technical inquiries, and prepare parts-kit specifications and standard operating procedure instructions.
 Build product knowledge, improve engineering processes, and provide technical support and training to other engineering team members.
 Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
 
Your Background

 Candidate must already have work authorization that would permit them to work for Hitachi Energy in the United States.
 Bachelor’s degree in electrical or mechanical engineering.
 Three to five years of project engineering or related experience.
 Experience with Dead Tank Breakers (DTB), Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS) and other high voltage systems is highly preferred.
 Ability to work independently with general supervision and address difficult, typically non-complex problems.
 Proactive and collaborative approach, with a commitment to conducting business with safety and integrity.
 
More About Us

 You will have opportunities to expand your technical knowledge while contributing to energy-service engineering solutions.

 Opportunities to work on innovative technologies shaping the future of energy
 A collaborative environment with experienced professionals
 Access to learning platforms and career development programs
 Attractive health and retirement benefits
 Paid leave and flexible work arrangements
 
 
 
 
 
 Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO)-Females/Minorities/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities 
 
 
 
 

Equal Employment Opportunity 
 Hitachi is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals, including females, minorities, protected veterans, and individuals 
 with disabilities. 

 Accessibility and reasonable accommodation 
 Protected veterans and qualified individuals with a disability may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access the Hitachi Energy career site as a result of your disability. You may request reasonable accommodations by completing a general inquiry form on our website. Please include your contact information and specific details about your required accommodation to support you during the job application process. 
 This accommodation channel is solely for job seekers with disabilities requiring accessibility assistance or an accommodation in the job application process. Messages left for other purposes will not receive a response. 

 Use of Al and automated tools in recruitment 
 As part of our recruitment process, Hitachi Energy uses digital and automated tools, including Al-supported solutions, to assist with activities such as application screening, job matching, and interview scheduling. These tools are designed to support our recruiters and do not replace human decision-making. Candidate data is processed in accordance with applicable data protection and employment laws as well as Hitachi's Global Data Privacy Notice.
